name: kanji-v1-baseline

criteria.fix: Add a skippable 3-step onboarding (target JLPT level → daily card goal → try one flashcard flip) with a progress indicator, ending on Daily Cards with the deck ready.
criteria.title: Fast to first value
criteria.evidence: Deterministic finding: no onboarding. The app launches straight into the Daily Cards tab ('Today's Deck') with no flow to set a JLPT target or daily goal.

criteria.fix: Ask for current/target JLPT level and daily new-card count, persist them, and use them to filter the home deck and preselect the quiz level.
criteria.title: Steps that do work
criteria.evidence: No onboarding exists, so no answers are collected. The quiz always defaults to `useState(5)` (N5) and the home deck ignores any learner level.

criteria.fix: Write onboarding copy in the app's dojo voice (e.g. 'Which belt are you? N5 beginner … N1 master') with a live kanji demo instead of slides.
criteria.title: Specific voice
criteria.evidence: No onboarding copy exists. The only voice is in-app lines like 'Your path from N5 to N1, one kanji at a time.'

criteria.fix: Create a paywall route with an outcome headline ('Pass the N3 in 6 months') and 3 real premium features, e.g. full N1–N3 decks, unlimited quizzes and the stroke-order view.
criteria.title: Clear value
criteria.evidence: Deterministic finding: no paywall. There is no screen describing premium value.

criteria.fix: Show monthly and annual offers with price per period, trial length, a 'Best value' badge on annual and a clear selected state with 'Billed $X/year after 7-day trial'.
criteria.title: Clear prices
criteria.evidence: No paywall, so no prices, periods or trial terms are shown anywhere.

criteria.fix: Add a header close button, a Restore Purchases button, an auto-renew disclosure paragraph and Terms/Privacy links to the paywall.
criteria.title: Required controls
criteria.evidence: No paywall: there is no close button, Restore Purchases, renewal terms or Terms/Privacy links.

criteria.fix: Present the paywall once after onboarding (dismissable) and when the user taps a locked N3–N1 level in the Quiz level picker; label it as test mode.
criteria.title: Honest and well timed
criteria.evidence: No paywall is shown after onboarding or at any locked feature.

criteria.fix: Add an entitlement store with isPremium. Gate the N3–N1 levels and the 'All' quiz length behind it, pushing the paywall route when locked, and show purchase progress and error states.
criteria.title: Entitlements wired
criteria.evidence: Nothing checks isPremium. Every JLPT level chip in quiz.tsx is freely selectable and the Progress LevelCards are open.

criteria.fix: Move the three stat tiles below the card (or collapse them into the header line) so the flip card and Known/Needs review buttons fit above the tab bar on a standard phone.
criteria.title: Core loop first
criteria.evidence: Home 'Today's Deck' puts the flashcard front and center with 'Tap to reveal' and Known/Needs review buttons that update next_review via nextReviewDate. However, in the screenshot the Known/Needs review buttons are clipped under the tab bar, below three stat tiles.

criteria.fix: Ship a real seed deck (all ~80 N5 and ~170 N4 kanji at minimum) and give the empty states a working next action instead of referring to an add feature that doesn't exist.
criteria.title: Real content and states
criteria.evidence: Seed data is realistic: 水 with スイ/みず readings, 6 quizzes with 90%/80% scores, a 5-day streak. Loading states exist (ActivityIndicator, 'Gathering your cards…'). But the whole deck is only 8 kanji across N5–N1 ('1 kanji' for N4–N1), and the home empty state says 'Once kanji are added' with no way to add any.

criteria.fix: Disable or hide length options larger than the level pool (show '4 (all)') so the selected control matches what will actually run.
criteria.title: Every control works
criteria.evidence: Known/Needs review persist via update(). Skip, Up next picks and View details work. Quiz saves results via addResult and guards double saves with savingRef. Weak spots: the Length segment shows '10' selected while the note reads '4 questions', and there is no way to add kanji, which the empty-state copy implies.

criteria.fix: Add a shareable result card at quiz completion or streak milestones (big kanji, score, JLPT level, streak flames in sumi-ink style) with a Share button using the native share sheet.
criteria.title: Distinctive and shareable
criteria.evidence: There are thematic touches: 問 badge on Quiz, 音読み/訓読み labels on the detail screen, a 'Sumi Ink' dark theme. But the quiz done phase and the progress screen have no share action, and the layout is a generic stat-tile flashcard template.

criteria.fix: Add a gear button in the Daily Cards header that pushes a /settings stack route with a native header title.
criteria.title: Navigation conventions
criteria.evidence: 3 tabs (Daily Cards, Quiz, Progress) and the kanji/[id] stack screen uses a native header ('水 · water'). Tab screens set headerShown:false with hand-built titles, and no settings screen is reachable from anywhere.

criteria.fix: Build a Settings screen with a Subscription section: plan status, Upgrade (opens paywall), Restore Purchases, and Manage Subscription linking to the App Store subscriptions URL.
criteria.title: Subscription
criteria.evidence: Deterministic finding: no settings screen, so no plan status, upgrade, restore or manage-subscription controls.

criteria.fix: Add an About section with Contact Support (mailto), Privacy Policy and Terms links (WebBrowser), and the app version from expo-constants.
criteria.title: Support, legal and about
criteria.evidence: No settings screen: no contact support, privacy policy, terms or version anywhere.

criteria.fix: Add grouped preferences: Theme (Light/Sumi Ink/System), Target JLPT level, Daily new cards, Show romaji, and a 'Replay onboarding' row.
criteria.title: Preferences that matter
criteria.evidence: No preferences exist. The Sumi Ink theme appears in a screenshot, but the user has no visible way to switch themes, and there is no way to change level, daily goal or replay onboarding.

criteria.fix: On Progress, drop the borders on the four stat tiles and render them as a plain two-column stat row so the 'Kanji learned 3/8' hero is the only boxed focal element.
criteria.title: Layout and hierarchy
criteria.evidence: Home has a clear focal flashcard with large 日, but three equal-weight bordered stat tiles compete above it. Progress is a stack of equally bordered cards (summary, 4 tiles, due card, level cards).

criteria.fix: Add the missing scale steps (e.g. 12, 6) to the theme instead of sm+4/xs+2 arithmetic, and set fontVariant: ['tabular-nums'] on stat values and score counts.
criteria.title: Spacing and type
criteria.evidence: A theme spacing scale is used, but with ad-hoc offsets (spacing.sm + 4, xs + 2, marginTop: 2) and hard-coded sizes (fontSize 32/40, lineHeight 18). The type ramp (headline/title/body/caption) is clear. Numbers like '3/8' and '72%' don't use tabular figures.

criteria.fix: Darken the primary used for small text on the pink background to reach 4.5:1, and raise the ProgressBar track contrast in the light theme.
criteria.title: Color and contrast
criteria.evidence: Both the light pink theme and the Sumi Ink dark theme are legible. Weak spots: pink 'Tap to reveal' on pale pink and the near-invisible progress bar track ('Card 1 of 5') in light mode. Quiz score colors are paired with numbers, so color isn't the only signal.

criteria.fix: Give the Skip/View details links minHeight: 44 (or hitSlop of 10) and add accessibilityLabel to the flashcard toggle stating its flipped state.
criteria.title: Accessibility
criteria.evidence: Pressables carry roles and labels ('Study 日', 'End quiz' with hitSlop) and font scaling isn't disabled. But 'Skip for now' and 'View details' have only theme.spacing.xs padding around a 16pt icon and caption text (~28pt tall), and the 30pt week circles fall below 44pt.

criteria.fix: Use the native large-title header (headerLargeTitle) for the tab screens instead of custom Text headers.
criteria.title: No slop tells
criteria.evidence: No emoji icons, gradients, TouchableOpacity or Alert confirmations; Ionicons are used throughout. The tab screens hand-roll their large titles with headerShown:false instead of using the navigator header.

issues.fix: Add a paywall route with monthly/annual offers, trial terms, close, Restore and legal links. Gate N3–N1 levels behind isPremium and open the paywall from the locked level chips.
issues.problem: There is no paywall, no entitlement check and no purchase path, so the app cannot make money. Every JLPT level and quiz length is free.

issues.fix: Create /settings, reachable via a gear in the Daily Cards header, with Subscription, Preferences and About sections.
issues.problem: There is no settings screen: no subscription management, support, privacy policy, terms or version. Missing privacy/terms is an App Store review risk.

issues.fix: Add a 3-step skippable flow (level, daily goal, one demo flip), persist the answers, and use them for the home deck and quiz default level.
issues.problem: There is no onboarding. Users are dropped into a deck without choosing their JLPT level or daily goal, so nothing is personalized.

issues.fix: Bundle a full JLPT kanji dataset with readings, meanings and example words, starting with complete N5 and N4.
issues.problem: The content is a toy: 8 kanji total, with N4–N1 at 1 kanji each, for an app promising N5→N1 progress. Users will exhaust it in minutes.

issues.fix: Move or condense the stat tiles so the flashcard and both answer buttons fit above the fold.
issues.problem: The core action buttons (Known / Needs review) are clipped under the tab bar on first view because three stat tiles sit above the card.

issues.fix: Add a styled result card (score, level, streak flames, a featured kanji) with a native Share button at quiz completion.
issues.problem: There is no shareable moment: quiz results and streaks have no share action or screenshot-worthy card.

issues.fix: Replace it with a 'Start N5 deck' or 'Take a quiz' button, or add an Add Kanji/browse-library flow.
issues.problem: The 'Once kanji are added' empty state has no action, and the app has no add-kanji feature, so it is a dead end.

issues.fix: Disable length options that exceed the level pool, or relabel the option as 'All (4)'.
issues.problem: Length '10' shows as selected while the note says '4 questions', so the control contradicts the outcome.

issues.fix: Expose a Theme picker (Light / Sumi Ink / System) in Settings, persisted in storage.
issues.problem: The Sumi Ink dark theme exists but users cannot choose it.

issues.fix: Set minHeight: 44 and a hitSlop on these Pressables.
issues.problem: 'Skip for now' and 'View details' are small text links (~28pt targets).

issues.fix: Unbox the stat tiles into a plain grid and apply tabular-nums to all numeric values.
issues.problem: Every section is an equally bordered card, which flattens hierarchy, and stat numbers aren't tabular.

issues.fix: Add a /paywall route with an outcome headline, monthly and annual prices with trial, Restore, close, renewal terms and legal links. Gate N4–N1 levels in Quiz and Progress behind isPremium.
issues.problem: There is no paywall and no isPremium entitlement, so the app has no way to make money. All JLPT levels are free.

issues.fix: Create a Settings stack route reached from a gear on Today's Deck, with Subscription, Study preferences, Appearance and About sections.
issues.problem: There is no settings screen: no subscription management, support, privacy/terms, version or preferences.

issues.fix: Add a skippable 3-step flow (target level, daily count, reminder primer). Persist the answers and use them to build Today's Deck and preselect the quiz level.
issues.problem: There is no onboarding, so the app never learns the user's target JLPT level or daily pace. The Quiz always defaults to N5.

issues.fix: Constrain the Flashcard height so the grading buttons are fully visible above the tab bar on a 6.1" screen.
issues.problem: The Known / Needs review buttons, the core action, are cut off behind the tab bar on first view in both themes. The user must scroll to grade a card.

issues.fix: Seed the complete N5 list with readings and example words and a meaningful N4 set. Disable levels with fewer than 4 kanji, since 4 are needed for distractors.
issues.problem: The content is too thin to be a real JLPT companion: 8 kanji total, with N4–N1 holding 1 kanji each. A quiz on those levels is meaningless and there is no way to add kanji.

issues.fix: Render a styled result card (level, score, kanji learned) on quiz completion with a Share button that uses react-native Share or a view snapshot.
issues.problem: There is no shareable moment: quiz results and streaks can't be shared.

issues.fix: Replace it with a 'Start N5 deck' button that loads the level's seed set.
issues.problem: The empty state 'Your deck is empty. Once kanji are added…' has no action, and there is no add-kanji feature to fulfil it.

issues.fix: Disable length options that exceed the level pool and fall back to 'All'.
issues.problem: The Length control shows '10' selected while the note says '4 questions', which is contradictory.

issues.fix: Set minHeight: 44 and hitSlop: 12 on both Pressables.
issues.problem: The 'Skip for now' and 'View details' links have roughly 24pt tap targets.

issues.fix: Unbox the 2×2 stat tiles, keep the 'Kanji learned' hero as the only card, and apply tabular-nums to numbers.
issues.problem: Seven bordered cards of near-equal weight compete for attention, and stat numbers aren't tabular.

issues.fix: Use a darker rose token for small primary text in the light theme so it meets 4.5:1.
issues.problem: Pink 'Tap to reveal' and pink caption text on a pale pink surface have weak contrast.

summary: KanjiDojo has a genuinely working core loop: an SRS-style flashcard deck, a meaning quiz that persists results, and a progress screen with streaks, all in a polished light and Sumi Ink theme. It is missing three of the five product pillars entirely (onboarding, paywall and settings) and ships only 8 kanji, so it cannot personalize, monetize or retain anyone past the first session. Next, bundle a full N5/N4 kanji dataset, then add a short level-picking onboarding, a compliant paywall gating N3–N1, and a settings screen with subscription, legal and theme controls.
